name: FM Modular Widgets for Elementor
author: Faiq Masood

sections.description:
FM Modular Widgets for Elementor is the ultimate lightweight, high-performance library of custom Elementor widgets and page builder extensions built for WordPress web designers, agencies, and developers. Supercharge your website creation workflow with over 35+ powerful free widgets designed with clean OOP code, PSR-4 autoloading, zero bloat, and full modular asset management.

Every widget can be individually enabled or disabled from the admin dashboard. Disabled widgets will not enqueue any PHP, CSS, or JavaScript assets, ensuring your site maintains 100% PageSpeed score and fast loading times.

Note: This plugin is an independent open-source project created and maintained by the author in a personal capacity. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any organization.

🚀 Why Choose FM Modular Widgets for Elementor?

  • 100% Modular Control: Easily turn off unused widgets with a single click to eliminate asset bloat.
  • 35+ Free Custom Widgets: Access a rich library of interactive, responsive, and beautifully designed Elementor elements.
  • Ultra Lightweight & Fast: Built with optimized vanilla JavaScript and clean CSS. No heavy external library overhead.
  • Fully Responsive: Every widget looks crisp and pixel-perfect on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

🎨 Included Free Elementor Widgets (35+)

🔤 Content & Typography Widgets

  • FM Button: Advanced button widget featuring 11 styling modes, loading spinners, glassmorphism, neumorphism, animated rotating borders, material ripple clicks, tooltips, copy to clipboard, and dual icons.
  • FM Advanced Heading: Typographic headline widget with auto-type typing sequences, multi-color loop words, 10 preset visual animations (flips, glitches, block reveals), and customizable tri-color gradient stops.
  • FM Animated Heading: Sequence loop rotating headline widget with multiple design presets, highlight styles, and layout controls.
  • FM Text Marquee: Continuous looping marquee animation for text banners with speed controls, direction switches, and hover-pause actions.
  • FM Code Viewer: Syntax-highlighted code block renderer with color themes, line numbers, and click-to-copy functionality.
  • FM Table of Contents: Automatically generated article index table with smooth scrolling, auto-nesting, and scroll-spy active heading highlights.

⏱️ Interactive & Navigation Widgets

  • FM Accordion: Collapsible text accordion widget featuring live keyword search filter, interactive custom triggers (hover, auto-close, auto-scroll), and 10 modern design templates.
  • FM Tabs: Responsive content tabs supporting horizontal and vertical layouts, hover/click triggers, keyboard navigation, and custom design templates.
  • FM Timeline: Interactive vertical and horizontal timeline widget with scroll-linked progress tracker fill, zigzag/left/right card layouts, custom marker shapes, and staggered reveal animations.
  • FM Scroll to Top: Customizable back-to-top floating button with smooth page scrolling, entrance triggers, and custom icon presets.
  • FM Tooltip for Elements: Interactive hover tooltip generator that attaches custom tooltips to any target container or element.

🖼️ Media & Visual Display Widgets

  • FM Image Box: Feature image box widget with custom mask shapes, hover filters, badges, equal-height layouts, and design presets.
  • FM Image Box with Ratings: Customer review image cards featuring star rating indicators, badges, and layout presets.
  • FM Before/After Image Comparison: Interactive side-by-side image comparison slider with drag controls and hover triggers.
  • FM Image Hotspot Locations: Interactive image mapping widget with animated pulsing hotspot pins and popover tooltips.
  • FM Image Gallery: Filterable photo gallery widget supporting category tags, dual source modes, hover zoom effects, and lightbox overlays.
  • FM Image Slider: Swiper.js image carousel slider featuring 3D cards, coverflow, cube, and creative layout templates.
  • FM Rotating Stamp: Curved circular SVG text stamp wrapping around center brand icons or logos with rotation animations.

📈 Business & Marketing Widgets

  • FM Pricing Table: Feature comparison pricing tables for subscription plans with badge highlights and design presets.
  • FM Call to Action: High-converting call-to-action hero banner widget with action buttons, background overlays, and title presets.
  • FM Basic Counter: Count-up number animation widget triggered by viewport scrolling with ease-out interpolation scripts.
  • FM Countdown Timer: Urgency countdown timer widget with due dates, expiry warning callbacks, and redirect actions.
  • FM Team Profiles: Team member bio card grid widget with social links, hover animations, and modern layout presets.
  • FM Testimonial Slider: Customer review carousel slider widget with client avatars, star ratings, and design presets.
  • FM Logo Marquee: Infinite scrolling brand logo carousel slider with pause-on-hover actions and grayscale hover filters.

🛠️ Utilities & Dynamic Form Widgets

  • FM Whatsapp Floating Icon: Floating WhatsApp chat contact button with custom welcome chat bubbles and pulse ring animations.
  • FM QR Code Generator: Dynamic QR code generator widget for URLs, Wi-Fi connections, vCards, and text with logo overlay support and PNG downloads.
  • FM WP Login / Signup Form: Secure WordPress user login and registration form widget with AJAX validation and design templates.
  • FM Advance Search: Live AJAX search bar widget with instant post search results and taxonomy category dropdown filters.
  • FM News Ticker: Scrolling news ticker headline widget displaying WordPress posts or custom news items.
  • FM Contact Card: Business contact card widget displaying address details, phone links, emails, social icons, and action buttons.
  • FM Advance Lists: Feature list widget with step connectors, dynamic badges, and customizable UI icon templates.
  • FM Social Icons: Official brand social media icon button group with tooltips, hover effects, and custom brand colors.
  • FM Youtube Playlist: Embedded YouTube playlist video player with interactive sidebar selector and custom cover thumbnails.
  • FM Calendar: Dynamic event calendar widget with date popup details and WordPress post integration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fm-modular-widgets-for-elementor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory (or search for “FM Modular Widgets for Elementor” in Plugins > Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the FM Modular Widgets admin menu from your WordPress dashboard to enable or disable specific widgets.
sections.faq:
Does FM Modular Widgets require Elementor to be active?

Yes. FM Modular Widgets for Elementor is built specifically for Elementor. If Elementor is missing or deactivated, FM Modular Widgets will safely self-deactivate and display a helpful admin notice.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

Not at all! FM Modular Widgets is built with a modular architecture. You can disable any widget you don’t use. Disabled widgets will not load any PHP, CSS, or JS scripts on your site.

Are these widgets mobile responsive?

Yes! Every widget is fully responsive and tested across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.

Can I use FM Modular Widgets with any theme?

Yes! FM Modular Widgets works seamlessly with standard WordPress themes including Hello Elementor, Astra, OceanWP, GeneratePress, and Neve.
